description: This file defines the NoSeekStream class, a stream decorator implementing the StreamInterface that disables seeking functionality for the underlying stream.

classes.name: NoSeekStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that prevents the underlying stream from being seeked, by throwing an exception on seek attempts.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws a RuntimeException to prevent seeking on the stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns false indicating the stream cannot be seeked.
